rows.feature: Phone and tablet layouts: bottom toolbar, ribbon sheet, touch handles, keyboard docking
rows.notes: Phone below 640 px, tablet to 1023 px (the Simplified ribbon), desktop from 1024 px. On a phone: the top app bar (Back, rename, Undo, Redo, Search, More options), the bottom toolbar with the selection's quick commands and the ribbon sheet (the desktop tabs as chips, groups as tiles, the same registry), keyboard docking through visualViewport, Back in the browser, Share, Write reflowing (Web Layout) with a Print layout toggle, Kiln Home with the floating New and the tab bar. Touch on every surface (part B): teardrop handles in Write's text and Deck's text, range handles at a Grid selection's corners, 28 px shape handles with a rotation handle in Deck and Write, the floating context toolbar (Cut, Copy, Paste, Comment, Format, More), long-press menus (the right-click menus), pinch-to-zoom and double-tap to the width; Grid's formula bar pinned on the keyboard with ✕, ✓ and the 123 / fx / A→Z quick keys, sheet chips with the selection's statistics, the AutoFilter menu and pick lists as bottom sheets; Deck's slide list with + and full-width editing, Present in landscape with swipes, tap zones and a notes toggle. Every control is 44 × 44 px or more.
